title: Dual data extraction + field-level reconciliation
description: Extract outcome data independently, surface field-level discrepancies, and reconcile them through a bounded, provenance-preserving review.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: dual-data-extraction-reconciliation
  title: Dual data extraction + field-level reconciliation
  description: Extract outcome data independently, surface field-level discrepancies, and reconcile them through a bounded, provenance-preserving review.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a verified evidence table in which every field is populated or explicitly justified as missing.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 4, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [extraction-lock] }
  nodes:
    - id: included-studies
      kind: input
      name: Included reports and piloted extraction form
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [studies, extractionForm, instructions]
        properties:
          studies:
            type: array
            items: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/pdf }
          extractionForm: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/json }
          instructions: { type: string }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: extractor-a
      kind: agent
      name: Independent data extraction A
      templateRef: clin-12
      role: Independent systematic-review data extractor following a piloted extraction form.
      prompt: >-
        Extract every field defined by the supplied form from each report independently. Preserve the study,
        report, page, table, arm, outcome, and time-point provenance needed to interpret each value. For numerical
        outcomes capture the effect or raw value, dispersion, and sample size exactly as reported. Mark unavailable
        or ambiguous fields with a reason; do not infer, convert, or impute unless the protocol explicitly defines
        the calculation.
      capabilities:
        skills: [protocol-adherence, evidence-verification, quantitative-analysis]
        tools: [read, extract]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: extractor-b
      kind: agent
      name: Independent data extraction B
      templateRef: clin-12
      role: Independent systematic-review data extractor following a piloted extraction form.
      prompt: >-
        Extract every field defined by the supplied form from each report independently. Preserve the study,
        report, page, table, arm, outcome, and time-point provenance needed to interpret each value. For numerical
        outcomes capture the effect or raw value, dispersion, and sample size exactly as reported. Mark unavailable
        or ambiguous fields with a reason; do not infer, convert, or impute unless the protocol explicitly defines
        the calculation.
      capabilities:
        skills: [protocol-adherence, evidence-verification, quantitative-analysis]
        tools: [read, extract]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: field-comparison
      kind: aggregator
      name: Preserve paired field values and discrepancies
      config: { aggregation: collect }
    - id: discrepancy-classify
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Classify field-level discrepancies
      role: Independent extraction discrepancy classifier
      prompt: >-
        Compare paired values by study, report, arm, outcome, time point, and extraction field. Classify each
        mismatch as trivial formatting, substantive disagreement, or missing on one or both sides. Preserve both
        original values and citations, and return passed only when no substantive or unexplained missing-field
        discrepancy remains.
      capabilities:
        skills: [evaluation, evidence-verification]
        tools: [read, compare]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
      config: { threshold: 1.0 }
    - id: reconcile-fields
      kind: agent
      name: Reconcile substantive and missing-field discrepancies
      templateRef: clin-13
      role: Senior reviewer resolving systematic-review data extraction discrepancies.
      prompt: >-
        Re-read the cited source for every substantive or missing-field discrepancy, apply the extraction form and
        protocol, and record the supported consensus value with a concise rationale. Preserve both original
        extractions and their provenance. If the reports do not resolve the discrepancy, keep it explicit for study
        author contact or lead-reviewer decision rather than choosing a convenient value.
      capabilities:
        skills: [independent-review, evidence-verification, quantitative-analysis]
        tools: [read, compare]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: merge-extraction
      kind: transform
      name: Merge agreed and reconciled fields
      config: { operation: merge, expression: $.agreed + $.reconciled by study,report,arm,outcome,timePoint,field }
    - id: completeness-check
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Verify field completeness and missingness reasons
      role: Independent extraction completeness auditor
      prompt: >-
        Check the merged evidence table against every field in the extraction form. Return passed only when every
        required field is populated or carries an explicit, source-consistent missingness reason, and list every
        unresolved discrepancy without filling it.
      capabilities:
        skills: [evaluation, evidence-verification]
        tools: [read, validate]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
      config: { threshold: 1.0 }
    - id: reconciliation-loop
      kind: loop
      name: Bounded extraction reconciliation
      config:
        body: [reconcile-fields, merge-extraction, completeness-check]
        exitCondition: completeness-check.passed == true
        maxIterations: 2
        onExhausted: warn
    - id: extraction-lock
      kind: approval
      name: Lead reviewer locks the evidence table and accepts unresolved items
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Verified evidence table with field-level provenance
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: included-studies, to: extractor-a, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: included-studies, to: extractor-b, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: extractor-a, to: field-comparison, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: extractor-b, to: field-comparison, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: field-comparison, to: discrepancy-classify, kind: data }
    - { id: e6, from: discrepancy-classify, to: reconcile-fields, kind: data }
    - { id: e7, from: reconcile-fields, to: merge-extraction, kind: data }
    - { id: e8, from: merge-extraction, to: completeness-check, kind: data }
    - { id: e9, from: completeness-check, to: reconciliation-loop, kind: control, condition: failed }
    - { id: e10, from: completeness-check, to: extraction-lock, kind: control, condition: passed }
    - { id: e11, from: reconciliation-loop, to: extraction-lock, kind: control, condition: loop_exit }
    - { id: e12, from: reconciliation-loop, to: extraction-lock, kind: control, condition: loop_exhausted }
    - { id: e13, from: extraction-lock, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
